stories.title: Pochettino's USMNT tenure had ups, downs and an ever-present mercenary feel
stories.summary: Mauricio Pochettino delivered some highs during his time in charge of the USMNT, but his focus never appeared to stray too far from a return to Europe.

stories.title: Source: Vols RB Morris out vs. Texas A&M after being injured in car accident
stories.summary: Tennessee running back Daune Morris sustained non-life threatening injuries, including a broken leg during a car accident Friday morning, the school announced.

stories.title: Falcons sign DE Thomas, CB Henderson to multiyear extensions
stories.summary: The Atlanta Falcons have signed defensive end Cameron Thomas and cornerback C.J. Henderson to multiyear contract extensions, the team announced Friday.

stories.title: Injured QB Jackson doing 'well' as Ravens eye 6-10 weeks out, Minter says
stories.summary: Ravens coach Jesse Minter's update on Lamar Jackson's recovery process calls such timelines "challenging to predict."

stories.title: Tearful Pochettino on USMNT exit: 'Toughest decision of my career'
stories.summary: Mauricio Pochettino has left his position as United States men's national team coach to manage Manchester United, the U.S. Soccer Federation said Friday.
